name: posthog-js-slim
description: Subpath entry point for the tree-shakeable core bundle, the smallest way to load PostHog. It inlines no extension: session replay, surveys, exception autocapture, web vitals, logs and the rest come from posthog-js/dist/extension-bundles and are passed through the __extensionClasses config, so a bundler keeps out every extension the site does not pass. It still installs the external script loader, so what it does not inline can still be loaded from the CDN. Use posthog-js/slim/no-external when no script may be loaded. ESM-only, like the extension bundles it composes with; consumed by bundlers via the `module` field. Types come from dist/module.slim.d.ts, which marks each tree-shakeable extension as possibly undefined because the site chooses which ones to include.
